d:
A 14-year-old boy, Aryavardhan Singh, died after allegedly being hit by a bulldozer during Akhilesh Yadav's PDA Rath Yatra in Gorakhpur. The boy was reportedly crossing the road to pick up his sister when the accident occurred. His father, a BJP leader, has demanded a murder case against Akhilesh Yadav and the rally organisers. The incident has triggered a political confrontation between the BJP and Samajwadi Party. What happened that day, and what are the allegations?
